relationships.description: Packager (bun scripts/package.ts) consumes harness/cursor/ and core/ to generate dist/cursor/ — the complete Cursor harness distribution.
relationships.mechanism: Reads harness/cursor/manifest.ts, applies coreDirs mappings, runs emit.ts for structural divergence, writes output to dist/cursor/
constraints: Auto-discovers harness by scanning for manifest.ts

relationships.description: Emitter generates .cursor/rules/*/RULE.md files from core method knowledge (memory/org.md, memory/team.md, memory/phases/) by adding YAML frontmatter with activation types.
relationships.mechanism: Transposes core memory/ content into RULE.md format with alwaysApply/description/globs frontmatter fields based on content category

relationships.description: Emitter generates .cursor/hooks.json registry file pointing to hook script files in .cursor/hooks/.
relationships.mechanism: Assembles JSON registry mapping AI-DLC lifecycle events to Cursor hook events with appropriate handler scripts
constraints: Must set failClosed:true for security-critical gates

relationships.description: Emitter generates .cursor/commands/*.md from the CLI utility handlers in core.
relationships.mechanism: Creates plain Markdown command files where filename becomes the /command-name slash command

relationships.description: Emitter generates .cursor/cli.json with safe default permission set for cursor-agent headless execution.
relationships.mechanism: Creates JSON with allow/deny lists using Shell(), Read(), Write() permission tokens

relationships.description: Hook adapter normalizes Cursor's camelCase JSON payloads to AI-DLC core's snake_case contract and translates permission:deny to exit code 2.
relationships.mechanism: TypeScript script receives Cursor JSON stdin, transforms field names and permission semantics, forwards to core hook logic, translates response back
constraints: Must handle all 10 Cursor lifecycle events
Must detect first-prompt for session init (cloud agents lack sessionStart)

relationships.description: The /aidlc skill (SKILL.md) serves as the entry point that launches the full AI-DLC orchestrator workflow inside Cursor.
relationships.mechanism: User invokes /aidlc slash command → Cursor loads SKILL.md content into context → orchestrator instructions drive the 32-stage workflow
constraints: Same SKILL.md standard as Claude Code and Codex — high reuse potential

relationships.description: HarnessManifest type defines the emit field signature that the Cursor emitter must satisfy: (ctx: EmitContext) => void.
relationships.mechanism: manifest.ts exports a HarnessManifest object with emit property pointing to the emitter function
